sections.h2: Goods trade peaked in 2024-25, then India's surplus became a small deficit

chart.title: Two-way goods trade eased from $1,298 million to $1,155 million in 2025-26
chart.sub: India–New Zealand goods trade, US$ million.
chart.source: Commerce ministry data for 2023-24 and 2024-25; Rubix Data Sciences compilation for 2025-26.

sections.means: Total goods trade was $1,155 million in 2025-26, as India's exports fell from 711 to 566 while its imports held near 589.

sections.means: Apples enter at 25% duty instead of 50% within a quota, and kiwifruit enters duty-free within its quota.
